balanced.description: Model for balanced-tier seats (programmer, QA, research).

deep.description: Model for deep-tier seats (factory, grill, managers, critics).

agents.description: Per-agent model overrides by agent id.

models.description: Abstract model tiers mapped to concrete provider/model ids; unset tiers inherit the session default.

afterEdit.description: Gates after each programmer edit: fast built-ins or off (the phase-end gates always run).

inputPerM.description: Estimated USD per million input tokens when the host reports no cost.

outputPerM.description: Estimated USD per million output tokens.

estimate.description: Spend estimates used when the host reports no cost; estimates are labelled as such. Global config or plugin options only.

pr.description: Release PR opener: the GitHub CLI, or off.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the API key, sent as a Bearer token.

embeddings.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible embeddings for brainstorm dedupe; unset uses MinHash/n-gram. Global config or plugin options only.

lspAfterEdit.description: Append language-server diagnostics to edit results.

searchProvider.description: Web search provider; the default is the first one with credentials.

depth.description: Research depth (advisory, shown in <factory-state> during RESEARCH): 1 brief, 2 thesis + antithesis, 3 plus a verification pass, 4 exhaustive.

cacheTtlDays.description: Days es_research_fetch serves a cached page without refetching; unset: 7, or 30 for documentation hosts.

searchTimeoutS.description: Timeout for one search-provider request, in seconds.

searxngUrl.description: SearXNG instance (else SEARXNG_URL). Global config or plugin options only.

research.description: Research-stage tunables (ported from the 0.7 configure tool).

domainPack.description: Active domain-pack constitution for RESEARCH (quant, biopharma or legal); unset keeps the legacy flat behaviour.

licenseWhitelist.description: SPDX ids darkharvest may depend on or vendor (a harvest plan may only narrow it); everything else is clean-room only.

phase.description: Phase audits: optional lets QA-passed phases merge without an audit; required refuses passPhase until the phase has a passed or human-dismissed audit.

audit.description: Code-audit gating tunables (set with `es config set audit.phase required`).
